name: Agilix Solutions
old_description: As a renown regional hub for education, healthcare, culture, and commerce, the Columbia community is the largest city in Boone County. The Columbia, Missouri Agilix Solutions branch serves customers throughout the region with an impressive portfolio of electrical supplies, automation innovations, and digital solutions. We also offer a wide variety of valuable services in the Columbia market, designed to help your team get work done effectively, efficiently, and safely. And you get it all with the and the exceptional customer service Agilix Solutions is known for.
about:
Agilix Solutions operates a branch in Columbia, Missouri, at 1815 Vandiver Drive. The location serves as a regional hub for electrical supplies, automation innovations, and digital solutions across central Missouri. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure in the provided materials.

The branch functions as a distributor for major electrical and automation brands, supplementing product sales with a suite of in-house services. These include MRO procurement, asset management, vendor-managed inventory and storeroom management, power quality and energy assessments, technical support agreements, workforce training, emergency support, wire and cable management, installed base evaluations, parts management agreements, facility identification assessments, drive start-up assistance, thermography scans, enclosure modification, delivery, kitting and product staging, and mobile jobsite product storage. The company emphasizes its local inventory and a network of locations that can source items quickly.

The Columbia branch targets contractors, educational institutions, manufacturers, medical device manufacturers, and panel builders and system integrators. It positions itself as a go-to supplier for these sectors in the Columbia area.

Agilix differentiates itself by combining broad brand availability with technical expertise, aiming to keep customer inventory stocked, operations efficient, and teams safe and productive. It highlights its local inventory depth and multi-location network as key advantages for rapid fulfillment.
